Derek should consider the Focusrite Scarlett Solo or the PreSonus AudioBox USB 96. Both are highly regarded for beginners, offering straightforward plug-and-play functionality, robust build quality, and excellent software bundles that include user-friendly recording software and instructional resources. They are compatible with most standard XLR microphones, which likely includes the budget-friendly ones he already owns.

The amphibian that can change its color to blend with the environment is the chameleon.
